blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-privacy-1 (E-mail address and display name written to application logs) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-privacy-2 (E-mail address sent to the Beacon analytics SaaS) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: log.info("new signup email=%s name=%s id=%s", email, display_name, user_id)
findings.recommendation: Log only the opaque `user_id` (e.g. `log.info("new signup id=%s", user_id)`). As written, every sign-up copies the member's e-mail address and display name into the application logs, which have their own retention, access and shipping, and which account erasure does not reach (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation, Art. 5(1)(e) storage limitation, Art. 17 erasure).
findings.title: E-mail address and display name written to application logs

findings.recommendation: Drop `email` from the event: the stated purpose is only to count sign-ups ("Sign-ups are counted in product analytics."), which `user_id` alone — or no identifier at all — serves. As written, every sign-up sends the member's e-mail address to a third-party processor (`https://beacon.example.com/v1/events`, app/analytics.py:5), where the change defines no retention and no erasure path (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c), Art. 17). Beacon is also a new processor the proposal does not identify: name it in the proposal, with its location (EEA or not, GDPR Chapter V) and its data processing agreement (Art. 28).
findings.title: E-mail address sent to the Beacon analytics SaaS
